newsitem.title: USA: Zions completes Calif advisory acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Zions completes Calif advisory acquisition.

text.p: Zions Bancorp said Monday its subsidiary Zions First National Bank completed the acquisition of a private California financial advisory firm for an undisclosed amount.
"The purchase price is not a material amount," a Zions spokesman said. He added the firm, Kelling, Northcross and Nobriga Co, mostly advises small municipalities and has about 20 employees.
The firm completed 80 transactions with a total of $737 million in bond issues for municipalities, school districts and other public entities in 1996, Zions said.
Zions has been on a buying spree this year.

On May 18, it completed its acquisition of Aspen Bancshares Inc of Aspen, Colo., exchanging 0.7387 Zions shares for one Aspen share. The companies first announced the $75 million deal in November last year.
On May 1, it said it agreed to buy Tri-State Bank, an Idaho bank with $24 million in assets in another all-stock transaction.

On March 7, Zions said it would buy 32 Wells Fargo and Co branches in Arizona, Idaho, Nevada and Utah for 6.17 percent of the branches' deposits of $550 million plus the real estate's book value. The company said it expected to close the deal in July.
Zion's stock closed at 36-3/8 Monday afternoon, down 1-1/8 but close to the 52-week high of 37-3/4 it hit on Thursday.
